name: 크레이버
visual_review: 붉은 머리·강한 눈매·검붉은 코트와 쌍권총을 유지했습니다. 웅크림·순간이동·공중 출현·양손 교대 난사·마무리 동시 사격·하강·착지의 몸/팔 동작이 구분됩니다.
motion_summary: Craver red messy longish hair, fierce red/blue-gray eye shape, black red combat long coat and TWO red-black pistols exactly from portrait. Official R teleports to an airborne target and holds it in air while rapid firing. Without a generic opponent, animate grounded guns-ready idle; crouch and cross two guns; compact red teleport flicker; reappear higher with knees tucked and coat tails floating; both pistols aim toward upper right; alternating rapid-fire left and right pistols with small orange-white muzzle flashes; turning hips midair; final simultaneous two-gun flash with short red bullet streaks stopping inside cell; lowering from air with knees bent; firm landing with red dust; uncross/holster-ready arms; exact original idle. Real suspended airborne pose and gun recoil; no sword/slash, no huge laser, face visible. Camera/ground fixed but intentional flight preserved.
